Bhāgavṛtti
gr. a C. on sūtras of Pāṇini by Vimalamati alias Bhartṛhari; said to be one of the earliest C. s on Aṣṭādhyāyī an. composed by the order of Śrīdharasena IV; considered a. second to Kāśikāvṛtti (kAtantrapariziSTa zrIpativimalamatinAmakena kenacid [Page327-b] viduSeyaM bhAgavRttirviracitA ityuktam); work divided into two parts Laukika an. Vaidika an. the order of the sūtras is not maintained.
Q. in Siddhāntakaumudī, Śabdakaustubha, Bhāṣāvṛtti of Puruṣottamadeva (8/4/68) etc.
On the identity of the a. see Bhāgavṛttisaṅkalana, p.. 1-4; also Y. Mimamsak, Saṃ. Vyā. Kā Itihās. p.. 338-63; AIOC. XII. ii. p.. 273-87; IHQ.

(1931) p.. 413-18. For add.. information see Pt.. text.
Kavīndrācārya 110.
Pt.. Bhāgavṛttisaṅkalana Bhartṛharyupanāmakena vimalamatinā viracitā (a. ancient C. on Aṣṭādhyāyī) Bharatīya Prācya Vidyā Pratiṣṭhāna, 31/144, Alwar Gate, Ajmer, 1964.
